title: Add lintel version command
question: Should lintel print its version so users can confirm which binary the hooks run?
context: After the hook repair, the four harness configs point at ~/.local/bin/lintel. A version command lets the user check which build is installed.

proposal.choice: Add a lintel version subcommand that prints a version string set at build time with -ldflags
proposal.intent: Let users confirm which lintel build their hooks call.
proposal.proposed_change: Add a lintel version subcommand that prints a version string set at build time with -ldflags
alternatives: Print the version from lintel status
proposal.why: A dedicated command is the usual CLI convention and is easy to script.
proposal.rejected_because: Status is about the gate, not the binary.
risks: The version string reads dev unless the build sets it.
acceptance_criteria: lintel version prints a version string and go test ./... passes.
